7 points d'Influence et un mana de la co: 7 Influence and one mana of the Spell's colour. Six points is the price of an Advanced Action at the Monastery.

The stronger effect destroys the Artifact.

Toute nouvelle carte gagnée va sur le de: Any newly gained card goes on top of your Deck.

Une Compétence et une Action Avancée: A Skill and an Advanced Action
Un jeton Commandement et le jeton Niveau: A Command token and the next Level token
Les Niveaux impairs améliorent Armure ou: Odd Levels improve Armor or Hand Limit and add a Command token.

Celle du bas de l'Offre: The one at the bottom of the Offer
Prendre la Compétence d'un autre vous pr: Taking someone else's Skill deprives you of the card choice.
Deux pioches : Unités Régulières (dos ar: Two decks: Regular Units (silver back) and Elite Units (gold back). As soon as a Core tile is revealed, the Offer alternates Elite and Regular.
Une Unité se recrute uniquement sur un s: A Unit can only be recruited at a site whose icon appears on its card, for its Influence cost. The Units Offer is only refilled at the next Round.
Sans jeton Commandement libre, il faut r: With no free Command token, you must disband a Unit to recruit another. The recruit arrives Ready and can be used right away, but not to pay for its own recruitment.

Soigner une Unité de niveau 3 qui porte: Healing a level 3 Unit with one Wound costs…

Une carte inclinée donne toujours un poi: A sideways card always gives one physical point, and never Ranged or Siege Attack.

Parer : un ennemi à la fois, jamais de P: Blocking: one enemy at a time, never a group Block.

Oui, mais seulement s'ils sont du même t: Yes, but only if they are the same type

Dans la Cité Verte, les attaques physiqu: In the Green City, the defenders' physical attacks are Poison.

Contre un joueur, il faut atteindre l'Ar: Against a player, you must reach the Armor. Against a regular enemy, the slightest Damage wounded.
Chaque scénario fixe la forme du plateau: Each scenario sets the board shape, the tiles, the City levels, the length and the end condition.

As many as Crystals of that colour. The colour of those extra cards no longer matters.
Mission de Reconnaissance : un joueur ré: First Reconnaissance: a player reveals the City tile. Then what?
Chaque joueur, lui compris, joue un dern: Each player, them included, plays one last turn
Si la Manche se termine pendant ces dern: If the Round ends during these last turns, the game stops at that point.
But du jeu et matériel: Goal of the game and components
Vous incarnez un Mage Knight : vous expl: You play a Mage Knight: you explore, fight and grow in power. The scenario sets the goal and the length; in competitive play, the player with the most Fame wins.
Votre Héros commence avec un Deck de 16: Your Hero starts with a Deck of 16 Basic Action cards, a hand of 5 cards, Armor 2 and a single Command token.
Le plateau se construit en explorant : d: The board is built by exploring: first Countryside tiles (green back), then Core tiles (brown back), where the Cities are.
Deux échelles vous suivent : la Gloire,: Two tracks follow you: Fame, which raises your Level, and Reputation, which weighs on your interactions.
La Source contient autant de dés Mana qu: The Source holds as many Mana dice as players, plus 2. At least half must show a basic colour, otherwise the gold and black dice are rerolled.
Trois Offres sont visibles : Unités (jou: Three Offers are visible: Units (players + 2), Spells (3) and Advanced Actions (3). Artifacts are never offered.
Les jetons Ennemi sont triés par couleur: Enemy tokens are sorted by back colour: each colour matches a type of site or opponent, and red and white are the most dangerous.
À deux joueurs, combien de dés Mana plac: With two players, how many Mana dice go in the Source?

5 cartes en main, Armure 2, un jeton Com: 5 cards in hand, Armor 2, one Command token
7 cartes en main, Armure 3, deux jetons: 7 cards in hand, Armor 3, two Command tokens
5 cartes en main et une Unité: 5 cards in hand and a Unit
Ce sont les valeurs du premier jeton Niv: These are the values of the first Level token. Units are recruited during the game.
Une carte Action porte deux effets : cel: An Action card has two effects: the top one, free, and the bottom one, stronger, which costs one mana of the card's colour.
Toute carte, sauf une Blessure, peut êtr: Any card except a Wound can be played sideways: it is then worth 1 Move, 1 Influence, 1 Attack or 1 Block. Never Ranged Attack, Siege, or an element.
Les effets de même nature s'additionnent: Effects of the same kind add up: play as many cards as you like.
Une carte ne sert qu'une fois par tour,: A card is only used once per turn, for a single one of its effects.
À la fin du tour, les cartes jouées part: At the end of the turn, played cards go to the discard pile. The others stay in hand, except those you choose to discard, then you draw up to your Hand Limit.
Quand le Deck est vide, on ne remélange: When the Deck is empty, the discard pile isn't reshuffled: you must wait for the end of the Round.
Défausser envoie une carte dans votre dé: Discarding sends a card to your discard pile; destroying removes it from the game. "Any card" never means a Wound.
Il vous faut 3 points de Mouvement. Vous: You need 3 Move points. You have March (Move 2, stronger 4), other cards, and no mana.
Une carte inclinée ajoute 1 point. Une c: A sideways card adds 1 point. A card is only played once per turn.

Non, une carte inclinée ne donne qu'une: No, a sideways card only gives a normal physical Attack
Oui, mais seulement une carte blanche: Yes, but only a white card
Les cartes inclinées n'aident ni les Att: Sideways cards help neither Ranged Attacks, nor Siege, nor elements.
Quatre couleurs fondamentales : rouge, b: Four basic colours: red, blue, white, green. Two special colours: gold and black.
Le mana existe sous trois formes : un dé: Mana comes in three forms: a Source die, a token, or a Crystal.
Source : un seul dé par tour. Vous le pr: Source: only one die per turn. You take it when you use it, and it is rerolled at the end of your turn.
Jeton : donné par un effet, il disparaît: Token: given by an effect, it vanishes at the end of the turn if unused.
